_comment: Manual ESPN display name -> football-data.co.uk name pairs for scripts/backfill_espn_schedules.py, used only where team_research.history_team and the normalised name find no club. Each pair was checked by hand on 23 Nov 2026 against ESPN's standings for every season it applies to: same league, same season, plainly the same club, and the only unmapped club on each side that could match. Matched without accents or case. Never fuzzy.
